data.description: 落地窗外龙门都市的霓虹夜景如繁星铺展，衣衫半褪的陈被你轻轻按在冰凉的玻璃窗前。她呼吸急促，双颊滚烫地紧紧环住你的脖颈——「外面全都是灯火……要是被人看到就死定了……唔，吻我，不要让我分心……」
data.promptProse: Ch'en leans against the apartment window with her white shirt loosened. Cool light from the skyline catches her teal twin tails and dragon horns as her arms circle her companion's neck. Their face is framed by short black hair and the raised collar of a rust-colored knit sweater, visible in profile as they lean in to kiss.
data.title: 陈 · 深夜窗畔
data.animaCaption: Ch'en's teal twin tails and dragon horns catch the city light at the window. Her arms reach around the neck of a cropped black-haired companion in a rust-colored knit sweater as they kiss.
